family: Союздорпроект серия 3.503.1-81, Выпуск 7-1 — 33 m precast prestressed I-beams (Russia/CIS)
description: Soyuzdorproekt typical-design series 3.503.1-81 (release Vypusk 7-1): fully transportable pretensioned I-section beams for 33 m spans. Four marks: B3300.174.153 / B3300.194.153 / B3300.174.173 / B3300.194.173 - marking per GOST 23009: B<length mm>.<top slab width dm*100>.<height dm*100>, i.e. 33 m long, top slab 1740/1940 mm, girder height 1530/1730 mm. Top slab 1040 + e wide (e=700/900), 180 thick with 30x30 edge notches, R300 haunches into a 200 mm web, bottom flange 620 wide with R200 fillets. Concrete B35 (h=1730) / B40 (h=1530); pretressing K-7 strand bundles (m bundles x n strands; bundle length k x 100 mm).
